user.title: Create a media system
user.description: Give this independently controlled installation a name. Start with existing media players, or import an advanced configuration.

equipment.title: Choose equipment
equipment.description: Select the physical TV, receiver, speaker or source entities for this system. No outlet or HDMI switch is required. Review generated power feedback before enabling control; Cast and playback-session entities may need advanced bindings.

activity.title: Add an activity
activity.description: Name the activity and choose the required inputs. Supported power-on requirements are added automatically. Leave an input empty to leave it unchanged. Advanced settings are editable after setup.

advanced.title: Import configuration
advanced.description: Paste the versioned configuration object. Importing never controls equipment; observer-only mode is enforced.

review.title: Review {name}

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure system
reconfigure.description: Edit the full configuration, or use equipment/activity subentries for individual edits. Saving returns the system to observer-only mode. Stable item IDs preserve references.

error.invalid_configuration: The configuration is invalid. Check capability references, supported values and dependencies.
error.controlled_resource_conflict: Another Media Activities system already controls one of these entities.
error.entity_missing: The selected entity no longer exists. Choose its current entity ID.
error.no_supported_requirements: No supported activity requirement was selected. Choose an input or use advanced configuration.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Configuration updated. Review the system in observer-only mode before enabling control.

request_activity.description: Prepare the activity and return immediately with a request ID.

finish.name: Finish media
finish.description: Finish managed equipment safely and reset preservation atomically.

retry.name: Retry
retry.description: Run one bounded reconciliation of the current activity.

set_device_setting.name: Set device setting
set_device_setting.description: Apply a session override through the equipment command lane.

cancel_requests.name: Cancel requests
cancel_requests.description: Invalidate pending requests for the specified origin.

apply_policy.name: Apply policy
apply_policy.description: Apply a configured equipment policy while rechecking its guards.

export_configuration.name: Export configuration
export_configuration.description: Return the versioned configuration. It may contain private entity IDs and action payloads.

import_configuration.name: Import configuration
import_configuration.description: Validate and replace configuration without actuating equipment.
